decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are close to the firm's established dental materials and custom-device workflow capabilities, and with strong in-house R&D the firm is likely to keep refining rather than abandon them.
A PETG thermoforming blank fits very closely with the firm's existing dental laboratory materials and process know-how, so absorptive capacity is high and continued commercialization is likely.

The UV-curing lacquer is still related to the firm's materials expertise, but as a less prominently presented line it looks somewhat more peripheral and therefore faces a moderate, not high, risk of being discontinued.

Custom hearing protection earmolds build on the firm's established hearing-care and custom-manufacturing knowledge, though the earlier pruning of another earmold line suggests some portfolio rationalization risk.
